question: How much did Oligo raise in its latest funding round?

hits.title: Oligo Raises $60 Million for Runtime Security - SecurityWeek
hits.snippet: Runtime security company Oligo Security today announced raising $60 million in a new funding round that brings the total to $140 million.

hits.title: Oligo Raises $60M to Extend Runtime Security to AI Agents
hits.snippet: Oligo Raises $60M to ... # Oligo Raises $60M to Extend Runtime Security to AI Agents ... A startup led by a former Israeli Military Intelligence captain raised $60 million to extend runtime security to agentic applications as enterprises rapidly adopt artificial intelligence. ... The funding - led by Ballistic Ventures, Canon Capital, Greenfield Partners, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Red Dot Capital and TLV Partners - will help Oligo identify exploitation as it occurs and block it before an attacker causes damage, said co-founder and CEO Nadav Czerninski. He said Oligo had developed the technology before agentic AI became a major enterprise security concern. ... Oligo, founded in 2022, employs 129 people and has raised $140 million, having previously completed a $50 million Series B funding round in January 2025 led by Greenfield Partners. The company has been led since its inception by Czerninski, who previously spent more than six years leading the Israeli Military's cyber research team (see: Oligo Security Raises $50M to Tackle App Detection, Response).

hits.title: Oligo Security Raises $50M Series B to Redefine Security for Modern Applications
hits.snippet: TEL AVIV, Israel--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Oligo Security, the leader in Application Detection and Response (ADR), today announced $50 million in Series B funding led by Greenfield Partners, with participation from Red Dot Capital Partners, Strait Capital, and existing investors Ballistic Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and TLV Partners. The funds will be used to fuel global go-to-market efforts to meet the increasing demand for the Oligo platform, which finds exploitable application vulnerabilities in real-time and stops cloud-native attacks. The round brings Oligo to $80 million in total funding in less than two years.

hits.title: Oligo Security raises $50M Series B to stop cloud application attacks in real time | Ctech
hits.snippet: # Oligo Security raises $50M Series B to stop cloud application attacks ... Cybersecurity company Oligo Security, which provides a platform for identifying and stopping critical security vulnerabilities in cloud applications in real time, has raised $50 million in a Series B round, bringing the company's total investments to $80 million in less than two years. The round was led by Greenfield Partners , with participation from Red Dot Capital Partners, Strait Capital, and existing investors Ballistic Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and TLV Partners.
